newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $116/dressed, firm-up $1- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $116/dressed, firm-up $1- USDA.

text.p: Trade continues fairly active on Wednesday morning, USDA said. Steers and heifers were firm to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 116.00, few 115.50. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 116.00, few 115.00-115.50.

Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand good, seller interest good. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 70.50.
